Method of Attack: RAR archive containing WSF file that executes JScript to download and install Crimace trojan which then downloads PClock ransomware
Impacted Systems: Windows systems targeted by ransomware PClock
Attack Vector: Spam emails posing as fax messages with malicious attachments
Indicators of Compromise: Emails with subject 'PLEASE READ YOUR FAX T6931'
File named 'Criminal case against you' in email attachment
